recipes.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté chopped onions and garlic until translucent.
Add minced beef and cook until browned.
Pour in canned tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve sauce over spaghetti and top with grated Parmesan cheese.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Grill chicken breasts until fully cooked, then slice.
Chop romaine lettuce and place in a bowl.
Add croutons and sliced chicken to the bowl.
Drizzle with Caesar dressing and toss to combine.
Top with shaved Parmesan cheese before serving.
